objective: Run a time-boxed spike that measures whether the auto-compaction threshold setting bounds the context on 1M-context Opus. Record the recommended setting in the framework docs.
why: ac2-1 is not-verified. The 2026-10-10 baseline has a main context mean of 489,792 tokens per turn and 18 compactions, 12 near the cap. ac2-2 to ac2-4 depend on the spike result.

include: A spike ticket with a budget and kill criteria
Two or more threshold values tried on the same scripted task in throwaway sessions
The o1 script session view before and after each value: mean and p90 context per turn and the compaction count
A spike memo under docs/spike-memos/ with the numbers and a recommendation
The recommended setting in the framework docs or the reason no setting is recommended
exclude: The compact prompt and the 300k target (ac2-2)
Any change to settings.json defaults or hooks
